textChanges.before: Civilian Seth in his red hoodie works on math homework alone at a softly lit kitchen table. An empty chair sits nearby, and a kept birthday card stands on a shelf.
textChanges.after: Civilian Seth in his orange hoodie works on math homework alone at a softly lit kitchen table. An empty chair sits nearby, and a kept birthday card stands on a shelf.

textChanges.before: They worked through the following weeks at Billy’s desk. Seth arrived in his red hoodie with schoolbooks under his arm. Billy cleared a space among the folders and made him put his pencil to the paper before deciding he was stuck.
textChanges.after: They worked through the following weeks at Billy’s desk. Seth arrived in his orange hoodie with schoolbooks under his arm. Billy cleared a space among the folders and made him put his pencil to the paper before deciding he was stuck.

textChanges.before: Seth stood beside the stairwell door in his blue suit, red gloves and boots, with the red mask straight over his eyes. Jenny had already changed into her pink suit with white stripes, gloves, boots and mask. Flaming Head hovered above the low brick wall.
textChanges.after: Seth stood beside the stairwell door in his orange suit, brown gloves and boots, with the orange mask straight over his eyes. Jenny had already changed into her pink suit with white stripes, gloves, boots and mask. Flaming Head hovered above the low brick wall.

textChanges.before: For a moment, all Jenny could see was a drum with red boots sticking out beneath it.
textChanges.after: For a moment, all Jenny could see was a drum with brown boots sticking out beneath it.

textChanges.before: He had slept properly. He had even remembered to straighten his red mask before coming upstairs. The steel drum was still where they had left it.
textChanges.after: He had slept properly. He had even remembered to straighten his orange mask before coming upstairs. The steel drum was still where they had left it.

textChanges.before: At dusk, Seth and Jenny came down to the quiet stretch of shore in their blue and pink suits. Flaming Head floated beside them, his fire turning gold against the darkening water. Perch rose between two rocks.
textChanges.after: At dusk, Seth and Jenny came down to the quiet stretch of shore in their orange and pink suits. Flaming Head floated beside them, his fire turning gold against the darkening water. Perch rose between two rocks.

textChanges.before: Perch splashed Seth’s red boot, just as he had the day Seth brought him home from the robot. Seth laughed, then wiped his eyes with the back of his glove. Jenny rested a white-gloved hand on his shoulder. The three of them watched Perch make one last bright loop in the water.
textChanges.after: Perch splashed Seth’s brown boot, just as he had the day Seth brought him home from the robot. Seth laughed, then wiped his eyes with the back of his glove. Jenny rested a white-gloved hand on his shoulder. The three of them watched Perch make one last bright loop in the water.

textChanges.before: The office door opened. Seth came in wearing his red hoodie, with Fist arriving through the window a moment later.
textChanges.after: The office door opened. Seth came in wearing his orange hoodie, with Fist arriving through the window a moment later.

textChanges.before: Jenny reached the roof in her pink suit and white mask. Seth was waiting beside the stairwell in his blue uniform. He had changed at home and hurried over. The steel drum stood where they had left it, its blackened patch facing the wall.
textChanges.after: Jenny reached the roof in her pink suit and white mask. Seth was waiting beside the stairwell in his orange uniform. He had changed at home and hurried over. The steel drum stood where they had left it, its blackened patch facing the wall.

textChanges.before: “There.” He raised his red-gloved hand and pointed.
textChanges.after: “There.” He raised his brown-gloved hand and pointed.

textChanges.before: On the rooftop in full superhero uniforms, Jenny stands in side profile looking left across the sky while Seth, viewed from behind, points right toward an approaching bright orange object above Cleveland. Jenny wears her pink suit, white mask, gloves and boots; Seth wears blue with red gloves and boots.
textChanges.after: On the rooftop in full superhero uniforms, Jenny stands in side profile looking left across the sky while Seth, viewed from behind, points right toward an approaching bright orange object above Cleveland. Jenny wears her pink suit, white mask, gloves and boots; Seth wears orange with white accents and brown gloves and boots.

textChanges.before: Daniel spread the newspaper across his workbench and held its corners down with a screwdriver and an empty cup. Super Zerdo looked back at him from a street photograph, the tank cradled against his blue suit.
textChanges.after: Daniel spread the newspaper across his workbench and held its corners down with a screwdriver and an empty cup. Super Zerdo looked back at him from a street photograph, the tank cradled against his orange suit.

textChanges.before: Luke studied the boy’s red mask. “You mean make me strong like him?”
textChanges.after: Luke studied the boy’s orange mask. “You mean make me strong like him?”

textChanges.before: Above the Cleveland rooftops, Luke’s iron jaws drive a surprised Fist toward a steel railing. Fist’s red leather is visibly scuffed and his empty white cuff is torn.
textChanges.after: Above the Cleveland rooftops, Luke’s iron jaws drive a surprised Fist toward a steel railing. Fist’s red leather is visibly scuffed and his empty red cuff, with its white inset panel, is torn.

textChanges.before: A close view shows Fist struggling low above a rooftop with scuffed, creased red leather and a torn white cuff while Luke’s iron jaws loom above him.
textChanges.after: A close view shows Fist struggling low above a rooftop with scuffed, creased red leather and a torn cuff while Luke’s iron jaws loom above him.

textChanges.before: On the street below, Seth came around the corner in his blue suit. He looked for Billy, then up toward the roofs. He could not see Fist behind the sign.
textChanges.after: On the street below, Seth came around the corner in his orange suit. He looked for Billy, then up toward the roofs. He could not see Fist behind the sign.

textChanges.before: She heard him. Her chair faced far enough toward the workshop doorway that she could see his red mask beyond the bench, at the service entrance.
textChanges.after: She heard him. Her chair faced far enough toward the workshop doorway that she could see his orange mask beyond the bench, at the service entrance.

textChanges.before: She sat beside him, still in her blouse and pink skirt. He was held against the second station by broad cuffs around his red gloves and boots.
textChanges.after: She sat beside him, still in her blouse and pink skirt. He was held against the second station by broad cuffs around his brown gloves and boots.

textChanges.before: A scrape came from the bench. Fist pressed his scuffed knuckles against the cage bars. His white cuff was torn. He looked at them, then at Luke.
textChanges.after: A scrape came from the bench. Fist pressed his scuffed knuckles against the cage bars. His cuff was torn. He looked at them, then at Luke.

textChanges.before: Seth in his blue and red uniform and Jenny in her white blouse and pink skirt are restrained at adjacent metal stations. Injured Fist is locked in a reinforced bird cage on the bench while Daniel and Luke watch.
textChanges.after: Seth in his orange uniform with white accents and brown gloves and boots and Jenny in her white blouse and pink skirt are restrained at adjacent metal stations. Injured Fist is locked in a reinforced bird cage on the bench while Daniel and Luke watch.

textChanges.before: Beside him, Jenny blinked against the ache behind her eyes. Her hands were still fastened to the arms of her chair and her ankles locked against its legs. Across the room, Fist lay at the bottom of the bird cage. His torn white cuff shifted as he tried to rise.
textChanges.after: Beside him, Jenny blinked against the ache behind her eyes. Her hands were still fastened to the arms of her chair and her ankles locked against its legs. Across the room, Fist lay at the bottom of the bird cage. His torn cuff shifted as he tried to rise.

textChanges.before: “I can bend these.” Seth looked down at his red gloves. “I should be able to.”
textChanges.after: “I can bend these.” Seth looked down at his brown gloves. “I should be able to.”

textChanges.before: Only Seth and Jenny could make sense of the message. Fist lay low in his locked cage, his torn white cuff folded beneath him. Luke’s iron teeth clicked as he waited for Daniel’s pencil to stop. Neither turned toward the window.
textChanges.after: Only Seth and Jenny could make sense of the message. Fist lay low in his locked cage, his torn cuff folded beneath him. Luke’s iron teeth clicked as he waited for Daniel’s pencil to stop. Neither turned toward the window.

textChanges.before: The cuff had not changed since Daniel last checked it. His hand was still inside, his red glove pressed against the armrest. He set his thumb beneath one edge without pulling his shoulders forward.
textChanges.after: The cuff had not changed since Daniel last checked it. His hand was still inside, his brown glove pressed against the armrest. He set his thumb beneath one edge without pulling his shoulders forward.

textChanges.before: Seth applies controlled pressure with his red-gloved hand to a slightly bowed but still closed steel wrist cuff. His hand remains secured as Luke’s floating blond head and iron jaws turn toward him.
textChanges.after: Seth applies controlled pressure with his brown-gloved hand to a slightly bowed but still closed steel wrist cuff. His hand remains secured as Luke’s floating blond head and iron jaws turn toward him.

textChanges.before: Jenny looked from him to the upper corner of his cage. No bottles stood between her chair and that corner. Fist lay low on the opposite side, his torn white cuff crumpled beneath him.
textChanges.after: Jenny looked from him to the upper corner of his cage. No bottles stood between her chair and that corner. Fist lay low on the opposite side, his torn cuff crumpled beneath him.

textChanges.before: Above Cleveland’s rooftops, Luke’s floating blond head faces Flaming Head ahead while scuffed Fist, with a torn white cuff, approaches from behind at a lower height. A recessed stair area is visible below.
textChanges.after: Above Cleveland’s rooftops, Luke’s floating blond head faces Flaming Head ahead while scuffed Fist, with a torn cuff, approaches from behind at a lower height. A recessed stair area is visible below.

textChanges.before: Billy stepped nearer the open threshold. Through the front room and the inner doorway, he saw a red glove on a boy’s hand reach past the bench. Jenny appeared beside him.
textChanges.after: Billy stepped nearer the open threshold. Through the front room and the inner doorway, he saw a brown glove on a boy’s hand reach past the bench. Jenny appeared beside him.

textChanges.before: Seth stopped walking. Color rose beneath his red mask and spread all the way to his ears.
textChanges.after: Seth stopped walking. Color rose beneath his orange mask and spread all the way to his ears.

textChanges.before: By the time Seth arrived at Billy’s office that afternoon, the lamp was on. He wore his red hoodie, with the sleeves pushed back from his hands. Jenny had brought the Defender. Billy made space for it between the folders and the telephone.
textChanges.after: By the time Seth arrived at Billy’s office that afternoon, the lamp was on. He wore his orange hoodie, with the sleeves pushed back from his hands. Jenny had brought the Defender. Billy made space for it between the folders and the telephone.
